en.hubeali: H 14735 – From him, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from jahm Bin Abu Juheyma, who has narrated the following: A slave of Abu Al-Hassanasws has said, ‘In the presence of Abu Al-Hassan Al-Musaasws was a man from Qureysh, who went on to mention the Qureysh and the Arabs. Abu Al-Hassanasws said during that; ‘Leave that! These people are three (types) – Arabs, and ‘مَوْلًى’ friends and faithless. So weasws are the Arabs, and ourasws Shites are the friends, and the one who is not upon the like of what we are on, so he is faithless’. So the Qureyshi said, ‘O Abu Al-Hassanasws! Youasws are saying this, so where are the prided ones of Qureysh and the Arabs?’ So Abu Al-Hassanasws said: ‘It is how Iasws have said it to you’.
en.sarwar: 287. From him, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from jahm Bin Abu Juheyma, who has narrated the following:

A slave of Abu Al-Hassan (a.s.) has said, ‘In the presence of Abu Al-Hassan Al-Musa (a.s.) was a man from Qureysh, who went on to mention the Qureysh and the Arabs. Abu Al-Hassan (a.s.) said during that; ‘Leave that! These people are three (types) – Arabs, and ‘مَوْلًى’ friends and faithless. So we (a.s.) are the Arabs, and our (a.s.) Shites are the friends, and the one who is not upon the like of what we are on, so he is faithless’. So the Qureyshi said, ‘O Abu Al-Hassan (a.s.)! You (a.s.) are saying this, so where are the prided ones of Qureysh and the Arabs?’ So Abu Al-Hassan (a.s.) said: ‘It is how I (a.s.) have said it to you’.
